t: This is St Leonard's, the old parish church of Shoreditch, standing where Shoreditch High Street meets Hackney Road. The present building dates from about 1740 and is Grade I listed. It was designed by George Dance the Elder. The bells of Shoreditch ring out in the nursery rhyme Oranges and Lemons. Theatre runs through the burials here. Richard Burbage, friend and business associate of Shakespeare, is buried here, as is the Elizabethan clown Richard Tarlton, and the playwright George Lillo. So is James Parkinson, who first described the condition now named after him.
